definitions.content: Closeness of agreement between the results of successive measurements of the same sample using the same instrument, under the same defined conditions of use, and within a relatively short period of time.

notes.content: The same defined conditions would include the following: method of measurement, the measuring instrument, the operator, the location and the ambient environmental conditions.

definitions.content: Étroitesse de l'accord entre les résultats des mesurages successifs du même échantillon par le même instrument, dans des conditions d'utilisation définies identiques et dans un intervalle de temps relativement court.
